name: Stretch Contrast
summary: Contrast stretch (auto-levels). Maps a chosen input range onto the full output range, which is how dark 12-bit-in-16-bit frames are made viewable. Reads 16-bit input unchanged and outputs 8-bit.

mode.description: percentile clips outliers, minmax uses every pixel, bits scales a fixed sensor range.

low.description: Low percentile in percentile mode; the sensor bit depth (e.g. 12) in bits mode. Ignored in minmax mode.

high.description: High percentile. Used in percentile mode only.
